{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patients
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check the total number of rows
total_rows = len(df)

# Check if any patient has multiple rows
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
duplicates_count = (df_grouped > 1).sum()

unique_patients, total_rows, duplicates_count"}
